what: 96 colored ink puddles scattered across the screen ride on the head of a single-stroke symbol (logo mark) and flow together, blending with each other (overlapping colors multiply and darken), and from where the head has passed they set into an ink-black symbol. For the first 0.34 they gather while twisting (0.65), and from 0.72 the head travels along the stroke from −0.08 to 1.7 (first 12% accelerates·last 20% decelerates, the last 0.065 is a tail where the thickness grows out). At each spot it passes, 36 droplets splash 350 away, and once fully set it shakes once with a 0.42s elastic (1.5 wobbles, damping 3.2). Hovering with the pointer swells ink within radius 155 by 22, and pressing or Enter redraws with a different palette (one of warm·ocean·berry·lime·ultraviolet·lagoon·camouflage·monochrome, different from last time)
ease: Leading-edge trapezoid speed (accel 0.12, decel 0.2) · gather smoothstep

options.dur: Drawing duration (seconds), default 2.587 — the original 3880ms at speed 1.5. Puddles sprout in turn during the first 0.25 (each puddle 0~0.1×2.5). Shorten it in the app.
options.width: Stroke width (symbol viewBox units), default is the path’s stroke-width
options.autoplay: If false, leaves it fully drawn when attached and waits for fx:play
options.interactive: If false, pointer swell and press redraw are turned off (the original home scene works this way — it redraws only via fx:play)
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Symbol SVG (viewBox required) — the first path inside is traced as a single stroke. Without WebGL2 this drawing remains as an ink-colored symbol
options.--fx-ink-1…12: First twelve palette colors (default CMY / RGB rotated from --kf-accent)
options.fx:play: Redraws when sent to the element — with a different color scheme if detail.recolor is true

note: The original is a shader that blends a puddle field over a symbol distance field. This part rewrites the shader with the same values (puddles 96 · radius 32 · gather 560×640 · twist 0.65 · leading edge −0.08→1.7 · tail 0.065 · droplet 36 · pointer 155/22), and strokes are received through a canvas mask drawn up to the leading edge. The plane (element) must cover the area where the puddles scatter (560×640 around the symbol).
